concerns.text: Task T015 (quality flag filtering) is listed AFTER T012 (alignment) and T013 (masking). Per FR-001 and the 'Edge Cases' in spec.md, cloud/aerosol flags must be excluded BEFORE preprocessing to prevent garbage-in-garbage-out. T015 must precede T012.

Task T013a (validate temporal overlap) is listed AFTER T012 (alignment). Temporal overlap validation is a prerequisite for defining the alignment window and interpolation logic. T013a must precede T012.
Task T020 (generate model_comparison.csv) is listed AFTER T019a (statistical significance test). T019a requires the comparison metrics to exist to perform the t-test. T020 must precede T019a.

Task T025 (in-situ correlation) is listed AFTER T023 (permutation importance). While T023 uses the model, T025 requires the model predictions (from T019/T020) and the in-situ ground truth. The current order implies T025 might run before the model is fully evaluated, but more critically, T026 (final artifacts) depends on T025's output. The dependency chain is ambiguous; T025 should clearly follow T019/T020 and precede T026.

Task T011a, T011b, and T011 are split into three separate tasks for fetching different datasets. While parallelizable, the description for T011 (SeaBASS) does not explicitly state it must complete before T012 (alignment) begins, creating a potential race condition if the pipeline script assumes all raw data exists. Add 'Depends on T011a, T011b' to T011 or group them as a single 'Fetch Raw Data' block.
